Metadata.title: Ivonea OS
Metadata.description: The Malagasy freelancer's office: clients, quotes, invoices and payments in one place.

Home.title: Find, win, deliver, get paid.
Home.subtitle: Clients, quotes, invoices and payment by MVola, Orange Money or Airtel Money, from your phone.
Home.ctaHint: Free to start. An email is all you need, no password.

points.crm: Your leads and clients in one place, with reminders so none slips through.
points.quotes: Professional quotes and invoices in ariary, euro or dollar, with NIF and STAT.
points.pay: Your clients pay in one tap by mobile money.

Auth.title: Sign in
Auth.intro: Enter your email address: we will send you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
Auth.codeIntro: Code sent to {email}. Remember to check your spam folder.

errors.invalid_email: This email address is not valid. Check it (example: name@gmail.com).
errors.code_invalid: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.unknown: Sign-in did not go through. Check your internet connection and try again.

step1.title: Let's get to know you
step1.intro: 4 questions to fit Ivonea OS to your business.

step2.title: Your business profile
step2.intro: This information appears on your quotes and invoices. NIF, STAT and tax regime are required to invoice.

trade.label: Your trade
trade.hint: For example: graphic designer, developer, translator.

experience.label: How long have you been freelancing?

clients.label: How many clients do you have right now?
clients.hint: 0 if you are starting out: a great time to begin.

Onboarding.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to continue.

grandir.name: Grow
grandir.description: Raise your prices and your income.

businessName.label: Business name
businessName.hint: The name shown on your invoices.

logo.label: Logo (optional)
logo.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 1 MB at most.

address.label: Address
address.hint: For example: Lot II A 12, Antananarivo.

currency.label: Default currency
currency.hint: The currency of your dashboards. It can no longer change after your first invoice.

nif.label: NIF
nif.hint: Tax identification number: 10 digits, on your tax card.

stat.label: STAT
stat.hint: Statistical number: 17 digits. Spaces are accepted.

manual.title: Direct payment (optional)
manual.intro: Shown on your invoices for clients who pay without using a link.

rib.label: Bank details (RIB)
rib.hint: 23 digits, on your bank details statement (RIB).

otherPayment.label: Other payment details (optional)
otherPayment.hint: For clients abroad: IBAN and BIC, PayPal, Wise… Shown as is on your invoices.

FormErrors.invalid_number: Enter a whole number, without decimals.
FormErrors.amount_format: Invalid amount. For example 450 000, or 1 250,50 for euros and dollars.
FormErrors.mvola_format: Invalid MVola number: 10 digits starting with 034 or 038.
FormErrors.logo_too_large: This logo is larger than 1 MB. Make it smaller and try again.
FormErrors.logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
FormErrors.logo_upload: The logo could not be uploaded. Try again.
FormErrors.reachable_required: Enter a phone number or an email so you can reach this contact.
FormErrors.date_past: This date has already passed. Pick today or a later date.
FormErrors.discount_too_large: The discount must be smaller than the subtotal.
FormErrors.lines_required: Add at least one line with a description and a price.
FormErrors.quantity_format: Invalid quantity: a positive number with at most 2 decimals (for example 1 or 2.5).
FormErrors.rate_format: Invalid rate. For example 5000 for €1 = 5,000 Ar.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.allDone: Well done, your getting-started list is complete.

lancer.title: Add your first lead
lancer.description: Someone to offer your services to: a name and a phone number are enough.

remplir.title: Add your current clients
remplir.description: Find them here to follow up and invoice them.

lancer.title: Connect Papi
lancer.description: To get paid by MVola, Orange Money or Airtel Money.

remplir.title: Connect Papi
remplir.description: Your clients pay your invoices in one tap by mobile money.

lancer.title: Prepare your first quote
lancer.description: A clear proposal, sent by WhatsApp or email.

remplir.title: Create a quote for your next project
remplir.description: Once accepted, it becomes an invoice in one tap.

Placeholder.body: This page is coming soon. You will follow your business here from your phone.

plan.title: Plan

limits.decouverte: Free: 20 active contacts and 3 quotes or invoices sent per month.

plan.change: To change plan, write to Ivonea.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.description: Papi for mobile money, and your direct payment details.

Payments.title: Payment methods
Payments.body: Connecting Papi is coming soon. Meanwhile, the MVola number and bank details from your profile are shown on your invoices.

db.document_frozen: This document has already been issued and can no longer be changed. Create a new document if you need to change something.
db.document_empty: Add at least one line with an amount before sending this document. A sent document cannot go back to 0.
db.invalid_status_transition: This status change is not possible for this document. Reload the page to see its current status.
db.workspace_tax_info_missing: Add your NIF, STAT and tax regime in Settings before issuing an invoice.
db.quote_not_accepted: An invoice can only be created from an accepted quote.
db.exchange_rate_required: Enter the exchange rate for this currency (for example 1 EUR = 5,000 Ar) before issuing the invoice.
db.invoice_due_before_issue: The due date has already passed. Pick a date from today onwards.
db.invoice_not_fully_paid: The payment received does not cover the total. Record a payment for the remaining amount to mark the invoice paid.
db.free_limit_reached: You have sent 3 quotes or invoices this month, the limit of the Découverte plan. Contact Ivonea to move to the Lancement plan.
db.invoice_not_payable: This invoice cannot receive a payment: it is still a draft or it has been cancelled.
db.currency_mismatch: The payment must be in the same currency as the invoice.
db.amount_too_large: This amount is too large. Check the quantity and the price.
db.default_currency_locked: Your main currency can no longer change: invoices have already been issued with it.
db.contact_limit_reached: You have 20 active contacts, the limit of the Découverte plan. Archive a contact or contact Ivonea to move to the Lancement plan.
db.quote_valid_until_past: This quote's validity date has already passed. Pick a date from today onwards before sending it.
db.payment_exceeds_balance: This payment is more than the amount still due on the invoice. Check the amount.
db.payment_date_in_future: The payment date is in the future. Enter the day you received the money.
db.quantity_too_precise: The quantity can have at most 2 decimals (for example 1.25).
db.not_authenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
db.payment_date_before_invoice: The payment date is before the invoice was sent. Enter the day you received the money.
db.too_many_lines: A document can have at most 50 lines. Group some items together.
db.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

Errors.title: Oops, something went wrong
Errors.body: This page couldn't load. Check your internet connection, then try again: your data is safe.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This address doesn't lead to any page. It may have been mistyped.

Contacts.title: Contacts
Contacts.count: {count, plural, =1 {# active contact} other {# active contacts}}

empty.title: No contacts yet
empty.body: Add a lead or a client: a name and a phone number are enough.

name.label: Name
name.hint: The person or company to contact.

phone.label: Phone
phone.hint: For example 034 12 345 67. Phone or email required.

Contacts.archiveHint: It leaves your list and no longer counts as an active contact. Its history is kept.

import.done: {count, plural, =0 {No contact imported.} =1 {# contact imported.} other {# contacts imported.}}
import.skipped: {count, plural, =1 {# contact skipped: no valid phone or email.} other {# contacts skipped: no valid phone or email.}}
import.failed: The import did not go through. Try again.
import.duplicates: {count, plural, =1 {# contact already in your list.} other {# contacts already in your list.}}

Contacts.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} contacts: refine your search to find the others.

Deals.title: Pipeline

empty.title: Your pipeline is empty
empty.body: Create a deal to follow a lead all the way to signature.

Deals.truncated: Showing the {shown} most recent deals out of {total}. Stage counts and totals include all of them.

title_field.label: Title
title_field.hint: For example: Logo for the shop.

contact.label: Contact
contact.truncated: Only the first {shown} contacts (out of {total}) are listed. For another one, open their page and create the deal from there.
contact.fixed: A deal's contact can't be changed. For another contact, create a new deal.

noContacts.title: Add a contact first
noContacts.body: A deal is always linked to a contact.

won.title: Mark as won?
won.body: Well done! The deal leaves the active pipeline. You can still change its stage later.

lost.title: Mark as lost?
lost.body: The deal leaves the active pipeline. You can reopen it by changing its stage.

history.title: History
history.empty: No exchange logged for this deal.

Deals.contactArchived: {name} is archived: this deal is on hold. Unarchive the contact to resume it.

Activities.title: Log an exchange

body.label: What was said
body.hint: For example: interested, call back after the 15th with a quote.

Activities.truncated: Showing the {shown} most recent exchanges of {total}.

Today.title: Today
Today.empty: Nothing to do today. Schedule a reminder from a contact or a deal.
Today.truncated: Showing the {shown} oldest of {total}. Mark them done or snooze them to see the next ones.

ReminderEmail.subject: {count, plural, =1 {Your reminder for today} other {Your reminders for today (#)}}
ReminderEmail.intro: Here is what you planned to do today:
ReminderEmail.footer: You are receiving this email because you scheduled these reminders in Ivonea OS.

quotes.title: No quotes yet
quotes.body: Create a quote from a pipeline deal: the client is already filled in.

invoices.title: No invoices yet
invoices.body: An accepted quote becomes an invoice in one tap. You can also create one directly.

client.label: Client
client.fixedEdit: The client of a saved document doesn't change here.
client.truncated: Only the first {shown} contacts (of {total}) are listed.

language.label: Document language
language.hint: Language of the PDF and of the page your client sees.

discount.label: Discount (optional)
discount.hint: Amount taken off the total, for example 50,000.

validUntil.label: Valid until
validUntil.hint: After this date, your client can no longer accept the quote.

rate.label: Exchange rate to {default}
rate.hint: How much 1 {currency} is worth in {default}. Used for your dashboard, not shown to the client.

form.sentWarning: This quote has already been sent. If you change it, your client will see the new version and must accept it again.

noContacts.title: Add a contact first
noContacts.body: A quote or invoice is always addressed to a contact.

detail.sendQuoteHint: The quote gets its number and a short link to share with your client.
detail.sendInvoiceHint: The invoice gets its final number and can no longer be changed.
detail.expiredHint: This quote's validity date has passed. Change the validity date, then send it again.
detail.rateMissing: Enter the exchange rate to {default} before sending this invoice.
detail.taxInfoMissing: Add your NIF, STAT and tax regime in Settings before issuing an invoice.
detail.acceptedHint: Your client said yes. Turn the quote into an invoice: same lines, same client.
detail.sentHint: Waiting for your client's answer. They can accept online, or you can mark it accepted yourself.

notices.sent: Sent! Now share the link with your client.
notices.accepted: Quote accepted. You can turn it into an invoice.
notices.converted: Invoice created from the quote. Check it, then send it.

email.skipped: Sending emails isn't enabled yet. Use the link, WhatsApp or your phone's email.
email.failed: The email couldn't be sent. Try again, or share the link on WhatsApp.
email.no_email: This client has no email address. Add it to their contact, or share the link on WhatsApp.
email.throttled: This email was just sent. Wait 2 minutes before sending it again.

paid.title: Mark the invoice as paid?
paid.body: Records the {amount} payment received directly from your client.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel this invoice?
confirmCancel.body: It stays in your history with its number, marked as cancelled. This can't be undone.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this draft?
confirmDelete.body: It has no number yet: numbering isn't affected.

confirmAccept.title: Mark this quote as accepted?
confirmAccept.body: Only if your client gave you their approval (message, call…). The deal moves to “won” and the quote can no longer be edited.

confirmDecline.title: Mark this quote as declined?
confirmDecline.body: Your client will no longer be able to accept it online. This can't be undone.

Pdf.draftBanner: PREVIEW: draft without a number, not a valid document

Share.quoteMessage: Hello {client}, here is quote {number} from {business} ({total}). You can view and accept it here: {url}
Share.invoiceMessage: Hello {client}, here is invoice {number} from {business} ({total}). You can view and pay it here: {url}

accept.title: Your approval
accept.intro: By clicking “I accept”, you accept this {total} quote from {business}.
accept.done: Thank you! You accepted this quote on {date}.
accept.justAccepted: Thank you, your approval has been recorded.
accept.outdated: This quote has just been updated. Please review this new version before accepting it.
accept.unavailable: This quote can no longer be accepted. Contact {business} to get a new one.
accept.error: Your approval couldn't be recorded. Please try again in a moment.
accept.confirmIntro: Confirm? Your agreement to quote {number} will be recorded and cannot be undone from this page.

payment.title: How to pay
payment.paid: This invoice is paid. Thank you!

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.body: This link doesn't exist or is no longer valid. Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
